name: feynman-notes
description: A visual mind-mapping and task management application.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix frontend --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend && node --test shared/*.test.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs
